stage: DSH Orbit v0.4 Stage 6 Local Multi-Process Rehearsal (Physical E2E Pending / Gate B HOLD)

scenarios.name: Selector Initial Shell with Node A and Node B
scenarios.expected: Selector renders Node A (NAS) and Node B (Workstation), both ACTIVE with reach ok and Open buttons
scenarios.actual: Selector rendered both Node A and Node B with active chips, health tags, and Open action links

scenarios.name: Open Node A real DSH in browser
scenarios.expected: Node A deterministic subdomain loads genuine DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 UI over verified HTTPS

scenarios.name: Open Node B in Tab 2 while Tab 1 remains on Node A
scenarios.expected: Tab 2 loads Node B genuine DSH UI independently without disturbing Tab 1
scenarios.actual: Tab 2 navigated to Node B genuine DSH on n-aa9764eb01b4e8a2e4b0d9906b0f9c6f.stage6.localhost:51558

scenarios.name: Subdomain and Node Route Isolation
scenarios.expected: Node A and Node B maintain distinct deterministic authorities with no crosstalk or cross-subdomain leakage
scenarios.actual: Tab 1 remains locked to Node A authority and Tab 2 locked to Node B authority; no crosstalk observed

scenarios.name: Automated Cookie and Gateway Credential Boundary
scenarios.expected: Automated route/gateway coverage proves outer gateway credentials are stripped and downstream Domain attributes are removed
scenarios.actual: Automated security-boundary coverage passed for gateway credential stripping and host-only downstream cookie normalization

scenarios.name: Mounted Browser Cookie Jar Isolation
scenarios.expected: A controlled parent-domain cookie is present only on Authority A and absent on the Selector and Authority B; gateway and Hub credentials are absent downstream
scenarios.actual: Not executed in the local multi-process rehearsal; reserved for the physical two-host Stage 6 rerun

scenarios.name: RouteIngress Outage Drill on Node A
scenarios.expected: Node A ingress down causes 503 node-unavailable fail closed; Node B remains completely unaffected and healthy
scenarios.actual: Node A returned 503 Selected Endpoint Unavailable; Node B route readiness returned 200 OK without degradation

scenarios.name: DSH Down with Ingress Alive Drill on Node A
scenarios.expected: Ingress detects unreachable DSH and returns 503 dsh_unreachable; Node B remains completely healthy
scenarios.actual: Node A returned 503 dsh_unreachable / node-unavailable; Node B route readiness remained 200 OK

scenarios.name: Node A DSH Recovery Drill
scenarios.expected: Restoring DSH A returns Node A to 200 OK readiness and Selector displays active state and Open link
scenarios.actual: Node A recovered to 200 OK ready and Selector immediately reflected active state with restored Open link

scenarios.name: Node A Deletion Drill via Management API
scenarios.expected: Deleting Node A causes Hub route identity revocation, tombstoned state in Selector, and disabled routing
scenarios.actual: Node A transitioned to tombstoned with disabled action in Selector; route requests fail closed

scenarios.name: Hub and Node Process Restart Stability Drill
scenarios.expected: Restarting Hub and Node B preserves persisted identities, DB state, and active eligibility without drift
scenarios.actual: Hub and Node B restarted successfully with intact identities and state; Selector and routes remained stable
